title: BFNAR 2016:10 Årsredovisning i mindre företag (K2)
source: Bokföringsnämnden, BFNAR 2016:10 Årsredovisning i mindre företag (K2), the consolidated version for financial years beginning after 31 December 2025 (vl16-10-k2ar-kons2025.pdf), chapters 3 (the form of the annual report), 4 (layouts), 5 (management report) and 18 (notes); BFNAR 2012:1 (K3) named for companies outside K2. Read 2026-10-09.
note: Cited, never copied. A company that does not apply K2, or a larger company, follows K3 (BFNAR 2012:1), which asks for more than this pack writes.

rules.text: The parts come in the order management report, income statement, balance sheet, notes, then the signatures.
The report states its currency and the unit of its amounts and rounds them the same way throughout.
The report is signed and dated.
The income statement and balance sheet use K2's layouts for an aktiebolag.
The management report describes the business and gives a multi-year overview of net sales, the result after financial items and the equity ratio.
The management report sets out the changes in equity.
An aktiebolag's management report gives the funds at the meeting's disposal and the board's proposal for them.
The notes begin with the accounting policies and include the notes K2 asks a smaller company for.

A company outside K2, or one that chooses K3, is told this pack does not cover it. Outside K2 by BFNAR 2016:10 punkter 1.1A to 1.1C (as amended by BFNAR 2025:2): a public company; a parent of a larger group, or of a smaller group that prepares consolidated accounts; a natural person or an estate; a bostadsrättsförening or bostadsförening; a company with a branch abroad; one that paid in shares for goods or services; one with convertible debt it issued or similar compound instruments; one holding crypto-assets beyond taking them now and then as payment; and one with a material deferred tax liability or buildings bringing at least 75 percent of net sales, unless the 1.1C exceptions apply.
